study_design: Prospective cohort study with baseline dietary assessment and 11 years of follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: During 11 y of follow-up, we documented 1012 incident cases of prostate cancer among 20885 men.
reason: The abstract analyzes total incident prostate cancer but does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared with men consuming < or =0.5 daily servings of dairy products, those consuming >2.5 servings had a multivariate relative risk of prostate cancer of 1.34 (95% CI: 1.04, 1.71) after adjustment for baseline age, body mass index, smoking, exercise, and randomized treatment assignment in the original placebo-controlled trial.
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared with men consuming < or =150 mg Ca/d from dairy products, men consuming >600 mg/d had a 32% higher risk of prostate cancer (95% CI: 1.08, 1.63).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
